snippet.title: TLATOANI - 1.0 RELEASE TRAILER | PARADOX ARC
snippet.description:
From humble origins to the heights of empire — Tlatoani: Aztec Cities is out now in version 1.0.
Build and manage a living Aztec city-state, honor the gods, grow your economy, and conquer Mesoamerica one city at a time. Rise as Tlatoani.

🏛️ Play now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161270/Tlatoani_Aztec_Cities 
💬 Join the community: https://discord.gg/A6nRnjUUe6
